title: Algorithm Definition
description: Schema for an algorithm definition YAML file, which specifies meta information and one or more statistical models.

models.description: Map of model entries. Keys are arbitrary model identifiers. The special key '_all_' defines shared configuration that is merged into every other model (without overwriting values already set on the model).

_all_.description: Shared configuration applied to all models. Values here are copied to each named model unless that model already defines them.

seq_spec.description: Parameters for R's seq() function. Must include 'from' and 'to'; use either 'by' (step size) or 'length.out' (number of values).

by.description: Step size between values. May be negative when 'from' > 'to'. Mutually exclusive with 'length.out'.

length.out.description: Desired number of values in the sequence. Mutually exclusive with 'by'.

predictor_allowable_values.description: Map of predictor variable names to their allowable input values. If omitted for a predictor, allowable values are derived from the variable-details CSV. Specified values take precedence over the CSV-derived ones.

oneOf.description: A seq() specification that generates a numeric sequence.
An explicit list of allowable values. Use numbers for continuous variables and numbers or strings for categorical variables.

reference_group.description: Map of predictor variable names to their reference (baseline) values used when computing model outputs (e.g. odds ratios). These set the initial slider/radio-button values in the UI.

oneOf.description: Reference value for a continuous predictor variable.
Reference value for a categorical predictor variable.

model_color.description: Color used when displaying this model. Accepts CSS hex colors (e.g. '#440154FF', '#21908C') or CSS named colors (e.g. 'red'). If omitted, a color is assigned automatically from the viridis palette.

shared_model_config.description: Configuration fields that can appear on an individual model or in the '_all_' shared block.

model_entry.description: A named model within the algorithm. Defines the display title, path to the model export CSV, and optional predictor configuration.

title.description: Human-readable display name for this model, shown in radio buttons and headings.

model_export.description: Relative path (from this YAML file's directory) to the model export CSV file.
